brief: Recognize that a benefit’s eligibility and withdrawal conditions must be checked before budgeting it.

title.es-MX: Revisa primero las condiciones del apoyo
title.pt-BR: Confira antes as condições do benefício

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Benefit Conditions"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Revisa primero las condiciones del apoyo"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Confira antes as condições do benefício"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Recognize that a benefit’s eligibility and withdrawal conditions must be checked before budgeting it.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: A benefit mentioned in an announcement is not yet money available in your plan.
instruction.misconception: Hearing about a benefit establishes eligibility, amount, payment date and unrestricted access.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: A benefit requires eligibility checks and pays later. Do not fund tomorrow’s bill with an unconfirmed future payment.
Eligibility must be established before assuming the payment.
The payment date arrives after the bill deadline.
A maximum is not each applicant’s entitlement.
The stated use restriction affects what the benefit can fund.
Changed circumstances may alter the applicable conditions.
Unconfirmed conditions do not establish usable money.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.

en-US.line: A benefit mentioned in an announcement is not yet money available in your plan.

es-MX.line: Un apoyo mencionado en un anuncio todavía no es dinero disponible en tu plan.

pt-BR.line: Um benefício citado num anúncio ainda não é dinheiro disponível no seu plano.

en-US.line: A benefit requires eligibility checks and pays later. Do not fund tomorrow’s bill with an unconfirmed future payment.

es-MX.line: Un apoyo exige comprobar requisitos y paga después. No cubras la cuenta de mañana con un pago futuro sin confirmar.

pt-BR.line: Um benefício exige conferir requisitos e paga depois. Não cubra a conta de amanhã com um pagamento futuro não confirmado.

options.label: Whether the person meets the conditions

feedback.met: Eligibility must be established before assuming the payment.

options.label: Si gusta el programa a amistades

help: Lee las condiciones reales de acceso.

options.label: Se a pessoa cumpre as condições

feedback.met: É preciso verificar o direito antes de supor o pagamento.

feedback.met: The payment date arrives after the bill deadline.
feedback.not_yet: Separate approval from when money is received.

feedback.not_yet: Distingue aprobar de cuándo recibes dinero.

en-US.prompt: Which amount belongs in the plan?
en-US.scene: An ad states a maximum benefit, but this person’s assessed amount is lower.
help: Use the amount confirmed for the stated case.

feedback.met: A maximum is not each applicant’s entitlement.
feedback.not_yet: Use the amount confirmed for the stated case.

feedback.not_yet: Usa el monto confirmado para el caso indicado.

feedback.not_yet: Use o valor confirmado para o caso dado.

options.label: Yes, every benefit is unrestricted cash
